verdicts.evidence: Independent derivation audit identifies H(t)^(N-1) as the sole N-dependent term in the Eq. (8) bound, confirming exponential contraction; numerical audit with 500,000 datasets per N-cell (N=2..64) shows bias contracting from +0.574 to +0.0016 and bound width shrinking 25.8x, with a destructive control where removing independent censoring causes the bound to fail by >10x.

Derivation audit independently checks the ADD-specific reduction in Appendix B.2 yielding Eq. (9); numerical audit with 500,000 datasets per N''-cell (N''=2..64, event rate 0.5, censoring rate 0.3, truncation b=5) shows all six bias±5SE intervals inside the analytic bounds, with the same destructive control confirming independent censoring is load-bearing.

GSR/Gaussian experiments with N=1000, 9 non-degenerate configurations across 3 length regimes and 5 prevalences, 10 seeds each: |KM bias| < |LB bias| in all 9 ARL configurations (10/10 seeds), and KM-ADD beats LB-ADD in 29/30 ADD seed-runs; at heaviest censoring, KM relative bias -0.175 vs LB -0.522.

Convergence experiment at N∈{50,200,1000,5000,20000} with support satisfied (T=5000) shows bias going -0.023→+0.005→+0.001→+0.003 with sd shrinking 2.65→0.46, while support violated (T=100) shows bias plateauing at -0.107 regardless of N—testing both directions of the condition.
The logbook explicitly states the WISDM real-data variance claim was not attempted; no experiments were run on the WISDM Actitracker dataset.

Gaussian sweep (N=1000, 10 seeds, prevalence 0.1–0.9, three length regimes) shows KM-ARL relative bias -0.014 to -0.028 in the paper's own figure regime; Poisson repair (N=10,000, 14 GSR thresholds, both fixed and irregular lengths) shows KM beats LB on curve error in 95.0% of 60 seed-cells with median ratio 0.567, and null-zone ratio 1.001 where truncation is irrelevant.

overall: The logbook provides concrete numerical evidence from executed experiments supporting five of six claims: theorem bound audits with 500K datasets per cell, multi-seed truncation-bias comparisons, convergence tests on both sides of the support condition, and simulation results across Gaussian and Poisson models. The WISDM real-data claim is explicitly unaddressed.
